newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Regent Pacific says Hong Kong IPO 12.1X subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Regent Pacific says Hong Kong IPO 12.1X subscribed.

text.p: Hong Kong-based global emerging markets investment house Regent Pacific Group Ltd said on Tuesday its initial public offering (IPO) of 42.63 million shares in Hong Kong was 12.1 times subscribed.
The international offering of another 127.88 million shares was also well over-subscribed by institutional investors, the company said in the statement.

Regent Pacific initially offered 170.5 million shares at HK$2.62 each, raising about HK$447 million. Of which, 25 percent of the issue were for public subscription in Hong Kong and 75 percent were placed internationally.

The company said it has reallocated a proportion of shares in the international tranche to the Hong Kong domestic offering, increasing the Hong Kong offering portion to 58.9 million shares and reducing the international tranche to 110.8 million shares.
Another 0.7 million shares for employees were fully allotted, it said.
Regent Pacific said it has granted underwriters an option to require the company to issue an additional 31 million shares to cover over allotment.
Dealing in the company shares is expected to begin on May 19.
The company said it had about US$1.77 billion worth of assets under management as at February 28, 1997.
